_kill_switch: Set `enabled` to false to suspend ALL autonomous processing. One field, one file. Suspension never rewrites lane history.

actor_allowlist._note: GitHub commenter identity is the only authenticated identity available in v1; actor_role is a claimed field, not a cryptographic identity (ADR-050 §6). All model roles currently map to the operator's account. Distinct bot identities are a hard precondition for ever enabling auto_merge. github-actions[bot] is allowlisted for SYSTEM events only — it must never appear under operator, or workflow-posted comments could claim operator authority.
